visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a woman with short dark hair and bangs, wearing a grey sweatshirt, holding a sleeping infant in a beige quilted baby carrier. She has a peaceful expression with her eyes closed. (2) The scene shifts to the same woman outdoors in a purple t-shirt, carrying a toddler in the carrier; she smiles at the camera while the toddler looks around curiously. (3) A man in a blue hooded sweatshirt is shown indoors, adjusting the same tan carrier with the infant inside, surrounded by domestic shelving and decor. (4) The man, now in a black tank top, is in a bedroom with a white crib, holding the toddler in the carrier; the toddler laughs happily, and the man adjusts the straps. (5) The woman in the purple shirt walks down a bustling city sidewalk with the toddler in the carrier, passing by storefronts with Chinese signage under cloudy daylight. (6) She crosses a street in a green urban area with a red bus visible in the background, maintaining a steady walking pace. (7) The final sequence shows the woman walking up an indoor staircase as the toddler on her front looks back and laughs joyfully at the camera.
